name: better-gpt
description: Cross-platform local MCP gateway with per-workspace tunnels

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @better-gpt/contracts && npm run build -w @better-gpt/core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @better-gpt/tui && npm run build -w @better-gpt/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @better-gpt/tui && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
